title: Understanding Confidence Intervals
text: A confidence interval gives a range of values that is likely to contain the true parameter value. If a confidence interval for a parameter includes zero, it suggests that the parameter might not have a significant effect.

title: Interpreting Confidence Intervals for Parameters
text: Look at the confidence intervals for each parameter. If the interval includes zero, it indicates that the parameter might not have a significant effect on the outcome.
